name: Tateshina (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tateshina town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised mountain peak.
history: Municipal flag of Tateshina, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 May 1963.

features.role: Tateshina town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised mountain peak
